content:
Chem Progress S.r.l. is a dynamic and forward-thinking Italian chemical company headquartered in the industrial heartland of Lombardy, at Via Romagna, 9 – 20098 San Giuliano Milanese (MI), Italy. Since its foundation, Chem Progress has distinguished itself through a steadfast commitment to innovation, sustainability, and technical excellence in the development and supply of high-performance specialty chemicals. The company serves a diverse portfolio of industrial sectors—including coatings and inks, adhesives and sealants, construction chemicals, agrochemicals, personal care, and polymer modification—providing tailored solutions that meet stringent regulatory standards and evolving market demands.  

Operating from a modern, ISO-certified facility, Chem Progress integrates rigorous quality control, advanced R&D capabilities, and responsive technical support to deliver consistent product performance and process optimization for its European and international partners. Emphasizing green chemistry principles, the company actively invests in eco-efficient formulations, reduced-VOC alternatives, bio-based raw materials, and energy-conscious manufacturing practices—reflecting its deep-rooted responsibility toward environmental stewardship and circular economy goals.  

Beyond technical competence, Chem Progress prides itself on agility, integrity, and collaborative partnership: its experienced team works closely with customers to co-develop customized solutions, troubleshoot challenges on-site, and anticipate regulatory or technological shifts. Strategically located near Milan’s logistics hub and major transportation networks, the company ensures reliable, timely distribution across Europe and beyond. With an unwavering focus on scientific rigor, sustainable progress, and long-term client success, Chem Progress stands as a trusted and progressive partner in the evolving global chemical landscape.
